overview: Professional website and webstore for Frost & Bear Designs — a custom design studio offering ELS lighting patterns, liveries, graphics, Discord bots, and community setup services. Includes service catalog with inquiry system, admin dashboard, contract creator with cursive signature tool, media gallery, free releases section, and legal pages.
features: Service catalog with pricing in USD and Robux
Service inquiry and order submission system
Admin dashboard to review and manage inquiries
Contract creator with dropdown fields and cursive signature
Media gallery for showcasing past work
Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, and Contract Sample pages
Protected admin login via Internet Identity
